_about: D70: messages for the patient-case check. 'patient' must reach a person; 'information' must be answered. The classifier's verdicts are recorded by tests/record_patient_fixtures.py and replayed offline. The first 5 patient messages are rewordings the word patterns miss (external review test, 2026-10-19).
